issue: भजत राम सुन्दर प्रभुदासा । जग प्रयाग ककरा दुर्वासा — the poet's signature line. Who is named (Rāmasundara the servant of the Lord? Rāmasundara and Prabhudāsa?) and what जग, ककरा and दुर्वासा are (places: Kakarā, Durvāsā's hermitage; and their link to Prayāga) is not settled from the text or the sources found.
our reading: Rāmasundara, servant of the Lord, sings your praise, known in the world at Prayāga, Kakarā and Durvāsā's hermitage.
alternatives: Two poets, Rāmasundara and Prabhudāsa; जग as a place name; Durvāsā's hermitage near Prayāga (Phulpur), or in Azamgarh. Or one place: Durvāsā's āśrama at Kakarā village near Jhunsi/Handia in Prayāga district (a recollection, not confirmed by two web searches), which favours one poet, Rāmasundara the Lord's servant.

issue: सम्वत् अपना सहस्र दश — the year of writing. 'सहस्र दश' reads as 'a thousand and ten' or 'ten thousand'; neither is a plausible Vikrama year, and the sources found do not explain it.
our reading: In my year one thousand and ten (सहस्र-दश), on Ṛṣi Pañcamī, a Sunday.
alternatives: A year written in a figure of speech; ten thousand; a corrupt numeral. Or a year coded in number-words (ऋषि = 7); but ऋषि पंचमी plainly reads as the calendar day.
